now.title: Fantastic Four (2005)
now.text: Ben is turned into a rocky giant on Doom's station, and his fiancée leaves him. He finds love with Alicia Masters and chooses to stay the Thing to save Reed from Doom.
cases: PR-009 The Brooklyn Bridge Pile-Up (Fantastic Four (2005))
PR-010 The Battle with Doom (Fantastic Four (2005))

proposed.text: Ben is turned into a rocky giant by the cosmic storm on Doom's station, and his fiancée leaves him. Doom's machine makes him human again, but he turns himself back into the Thing to save Reed, and he finds love with Alicia Masters.

changes.evidence: Fantastic Four (2005): Victor powers Reed's machine and turns Ben back to normal, then kidnaps Reed; Ben arrives to help 'having transformed himself back into the Thing by reusing the machine'. He does not 'stay' the Thing; he chooses to become it again. Alicia relationship confirmed in the epilogue.

now.title: Echo
now.text: Maya's prosthetic is wrecked in a train coupling. Skully builds her a new one and later gives it a new look.

proposed.text: Maya's prosthetic is damaged when it jams in a train coupling, and Skully makes her a temporary leg. He later brings back her repaired prosthetic with a new Choctaw cover.

changes.evidence: Echo ep 1: her prosthetic gets stuck in a coupler; she asks Skully to fix it and 'as he made her a temporary leg' he teaches her about Chafa. Ep 3: Skully 'brought her repaired prosthetic leg, as well as a cover representing the Choctaw people'. Skully repairs and covers her original leg; he does not build a new one that later gets the new look.

now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 114, Agent Keller grows close to Elena, until a Shrike possesses him and she must kill it.

proposed.text: In episode 114, Agent Keller grows close to Elena, until a Shrike forces its way into his body and she must kill him before it transforms him.

changes.evidence: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S6E4 'Code Yellow' (episode 114): the Shrike enters Keller through his mouth; as his body starts to transform, Yo-Yo stabs him with the knife, 'stopping the transforming and killing Keller'. Elena kills Keller himself, not just the Shrike as the current text reads.

now.title: Spider-Noir
now.text: Faber finally makes a cure from Ben's organs and uses it to restore her son Ogden's true age.

proposed.text: Faber finally makes a cure from Ben's liver and uses it to restore her son Ogden's true age.

changes.evidence: Spider-Noir S1E6 'Nightmare on a Gurney': after Reilly's blood offers no clues, Alethea harvests his liver and from it synthesizes the antidote that restores Ogden to his youthful look. One organ (the liver), not 'organs'.

owner_calls.question: Step 2 (Loki S2 finale) has status 'Allied'. The finale shows X-5 only as Brad Wolfe on a jet ski magazine cover, living a new life on a branch. He never sides with the heroes: he joined Renslayer and pruned her only under Sylvie's spell. Keep 'Allied', or change it to 'At large'?
owner_calls.evidence: Fandom: 'Following the reformation of the Time Variance Authority, Wolfe started a new life in one of the timelines that resulted in him being featured in a jet ski magazine.' Nothing shows him allied with Loki or the TVA.
